name: models3d_multicolor
description: Reduce a textured GLB to a palette of flat colours with Hi3D. An untextured model fails: texture it first with `models3d_retexture`.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed textured GLB: from `models3d_generate`, `creations_search` or an upload.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.
